meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track and update team goals + KPIs via the Deeplake virtual filesystem at memory/goal/ and memory/kpi/. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并追踪团队目标与关键成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理团队目标、KPI和任务进度
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and key results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage team goals, KPIs, and task progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过 Deeplake 虚拟文件系统创建、跟踪和更新团队目标与 KPI，将目标、任务、待办事项等统一管理为 Markdown 文件，并支持自动从 git commit 推断进度。
howto.when: 当用户提到目标、KPI、里程碑、任务、待办事项等可衡量事项时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个目标：本月完成5个PR。
say.note: Claude 会生成 UUID 并写入目标文件。

say.text: 给这个目标添加一个KPI：PR合并数。
say.note: Claude 会创建对应的 KPI 文件。

say.text: 记录一下：修复webhook限流问题，稍后继续。
say.note: Claude 会保存上下文，下次可恢复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates, tracks, and updates team goals and KPIs via the Deeplake virtual filesystem, managing goals, tasks, and todos as Markdown files, with auto-progress inference from git commits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions goals, KPIs, milestones, tasks, todos, or any measurable item.

say_en.text: Create a goal: complete 5 PRs this month.
say_en.note: Claude generates a UUID and writes the goal file.

say_en.text: Add a KPI to this goal: PRs merged.
say_en.note: Claude creates the corresponding KPI file.

say_en.text: Save this: fix webhook rate limiting, resume later.
say_en.note: Claude saves context for later resumption.
